coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 counter-mode 这一实体：计数器块、密钥流、唯一性要求、并行与随机访问，以及重用和回绕边界；不把 AES、GCM、TLS 或其他模式并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the counter-mode entity: counter blocks, keystream, uniqueness requirements, parallelism and random access, and reuse and wrap-around boundaries. It does not absorb AES, GCM, TLS or other modes.
